title: Florida Steakhouse: Texas Cattle Company, earns national recognition as one of America's best spots - NewsBreak
text:
4 hours ago Texas Cattle Company has been a local favorite for years. Photo by Captured image/Texas Cattle Company Texas Cattle Company has landed a spot on USA TODAY Network's list of the 20 best local steakhouses in America, proving that sometimes the best beef isn't only found in the Lone Star State.
The family-owned restaurant at 735 E. Main Street has been serving flame-broiled steaks to locals since 1984, when it took over the space originally opened as Talk of the Town steakhouse in 1974. The Woodsby family, who also own notable eateries Charley's Steak House and FishBones, has built a solid reputation over five decades by hand-cutting and seasoning USDA prime and choice aged steaks daily.
"Texas Cattle Company has been a local favorite, family-owned and operated restaurant for over 50 years in Lakeland, Florida," the restaurant wrote on its official website . "Our managers hand-cut and season our USDA Prime & Choice aged steaks daily to guarantee absolutely the best steaks anywhere!"
Texas Cattle Company is a local family-owned restaurant in Florida. Photo by Captured image/Texas Cattle Company The secret behind their success? Each cut gets aged four to six weeks, then flame-broiled over a 1,200-degree citrus- and oak-wood-burning pit. The signature Cattle Baron Ribeye, buttered filet mignon, and generous T-bone portions draw crowds from across Central Florida, including Orlando-area vacationers looking for a break from theme park food.
"The mellow smoke from the citrus wood works equally well with steak and seafood, while the oak burns hot and even keeping the flame consistent on our 1200-degree pit," the restaurant said. With a strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 4,800 Google reviews, customer feedback backs up the hype.
"This place is awesome! Probably the best dining experience I've had in years," Mark Gilbert wrote. Jemma Sullivan praised her 21-day dry-aged bone-in strip steak as "so flavorful and cooked perfectly," adding that everything from escargot to dessert hit the mark.
Yelp reviewers echo that enthusiasm. "Such a good steakhouse, def the best Lakeland has to offer," wrote Tina J., a Yelp Elite member. Dan B. highlighted not just the food but the atmosphere, noting "great country music" and "excellent bar staff."
Located near downtown Lakeland's scenic Lake Mirror , the Western-themed restaurant offers more than just great steaks. Generous portions mean leftovers are practically guaranteed, and birthday guests score a free steak to celebrate.
